usedFor: Helpcrunch holds customer chats, and “Create Contact” and “Add Tag to Customer” add and sort people from other steps.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Helpcrunch
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is a real customer, and the action adds them as a contact.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so a contact from “Create Contact” appears at the next run.
